meta.name: Chandigarh University, Mohali (Gharuan) - Official Campus Map Layout
meta.description: Reconstructed layout based on official Chandigarh University Campus Guide Map ("Know Where You Are"), cu_map_manifest.json and official publications.

sources.title: Chandigarh University Official Campus Map (Know Where You Are)
sources.used: Official Academic Blocks (A1-A3, B1-B5, C1-C3 with C2 below C1 on right side of Main Ground, D1-D8, DD1-DD4), Hostels, Gates (1, 2, 3, 8/4, VIP), Main Ground, Sports Complex. B3=DSW, B4=Kalpana Chawla, D6=Central Library per user-verified corrections.

meta.coordinateSystem: Local tangent plane, metres. x = east, z = south (north is -z). Origin = meta.origin (lat/lon).

quality.statement: All building positions, footprints, heights and path alignments are estimates. Only a subset of names is confirmed by CU pages. Routes are indicative, not surveyed.
